562:t_1:86.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Just because you're scared of reaching $$あがり$$, why won't you look at me!?」

562:t_1:87.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It's because I was $$トップレス$$ that it turned out like this!」

562:t_1:89.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「At my age, what's all this about $$バスターマシン$$!? What's this candy-type nonsense!? I look like an idiot!」

562:t_1:91.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「To think he'd been driven into a corner that badly...」

562:t_1:97.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Why did things end up like this...」

562:t_1:101.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You didn't talk back to $$ニコラ$$, $$シンジ$$...」

562:t_1:102.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Like, 'What do you know...? I've been through more than you could ever imagine...'」

562:t_1:104.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I can kind of tell. After you parted from us, $$シンジ$$, you went through a really painful time...」

562:t_1:105.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「It's not just me. $$赤木$$ and everyone in the Volunteer Club understands that too.」

562:t_1:106.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...Is it wrong to start over...?」

562:t_1:108.en:
$$シンジ$$
「If there's a way to go back to the past and start everything over, is it wrong to use it?」

562:t_1:109.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I understand that a method that wipes out everyone in the world, like that $$レナード$$ guy's, isn't okay.」

562:t_1:110.en:
$$シンジ$$
「But if there's a way to start over without it coming to that, then I...」

562:t_1:111.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...I don't know the answer either.」

562:t_1:114.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Because no matter how painful or sad things were, the me of today was made by that time.」

562:t_1:115.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So even if I regret the past or feel sad sometimes, I won't deny who I am now and try to turn things back.」

562:t_1:116.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...Don't you want to go back to the world you came from, $$ノリコ$$?」

562:t_1:117.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'd be lying if I said I didn't...」

562:t_1:118.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But I was prepared for this.」

562:t_1:120.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The final battle against the $$宇宙怪獣$$ in the world I came from... To make it succeed, Big Sis and I chose to be left behind in the flow of time.」

562:t_1:121.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「A distant future where no one remembers us... Human civilization might not even exist there anymore...」

562:t_1:122.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We knew that if $$ガンバスター$$ could return to normal space, the world would be like that, but we chose it anyway.」

562:t_1:123.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Why did you make that choice...」

562:t_1:124.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「To protect everyone... That was our mission.」

562:t_1:125.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「In the end, we didn't reach the distant future at all. We came to a world we knew nothing about.」

562:t_1:127.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But you know, $$シンジ$$... I don't regret it at all.」

562:t_1:128.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'm not trying to look cool, but I'm so busy giving everything to protect this world right now that I don't have time to think about that.」

562:t_1:131.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Feelings go beyond time and space... No matter where you are or how much time passes, what matters most is always in your heart...」

562:t_1:132.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(Big Sis carried her feelings for $$コーチ$$ in her heart, and devoted the time she spent with $$コーチ$$ to the fight to protect Earth...)

562:t_1:133.en:
$$ノリコ$$
($$ノリコ$$ is the same. That's why Big Sis is always together with $$ノリコ$$...)

562:t_2:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「To think that the $$時空震動弾$$ would lead to a result like this...」

562:t_2:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That $c's feelings would overlap with the $$時空震動$$ and reach the $$黒い太陽#sol$$...」

562:t_2:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Temporary though it was, that region became a universe where causality was completely warped and cause and effect blurred together... a $$カオス・コスモス$$.」

562:t_2:6.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「What do you think will become of them?」

562:t_2:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Let me change the question. What would you wish for, cursed wanderer?」

562:t_2:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Would you want to start over? To go back to before you met those three?」

562:t_10:4.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Welcome. As shop owner $$ＡＧ$$ is absent today, we will be running the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ under our caretaker service.」

562:t_10:5.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Furthermore, as for the congratulations to ace pilots, we ask your understanding that they will be held on another occasion.」

562:t_10:6.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Now then, everyone, please take your time and enjoy your shopping.」

563:t_000:0.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「Is this thing a black hole...!?」

563:t_000:1.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「I don't see any extreme gravity, though...」

563:t_000:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「It would be more accurate to call it a state where the distortion of the dimensional boundary line has peaked and become fixed as it is.」

563:t_000:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Something is coming through here...」

563:t_000:4.en:
$$フェルト$$
「We haven't confirmed the first wave, but according to the reports, there weren't that many of them.」

563:t_000:5.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「So those guys scattered across the $$地球圏$$.」

563:t_000:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「Nine times out of ten, it's $$バアル$$.」

563:t_000:7.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「So, in the middle of this pinch, what's going on with all the $$トップレス$$ folks?」

563:t_000:16.en:
$$チコ$$
「It's a delicate issue, so it's not something outsiders should butt into.」

563:t_000:17.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But fighting in this state...」

563:t_000:19.en:
$$クェス$$
「Isn't that a little cold, $$アムロ$$?」
